Apple HDRGainMap XMP: libultrahdr reads HDRGainMapHeadroom as a log2 value (exp2) and builds metadata from it; gainmap keeps it raw with metadata None, so the status line and the metadata lines differ. The size and channel lines (uhdr-dims), the coded bytes and the pixels are compared and must be equal (docs/parity.md)
libavif ignores a gain map when the file lacks the tmap brand (status no-gainmap); gainmap keeps the gain map (never-drop rule, docs/parity.md)

libavif ignores the gain map because the altr group does not list the tmap item before the base item (avifIsPreferredAlternativeTo in read.c, test DecodeWrongAltr: status no-gainmap); gainmap keeps the gain map and its metadata (never-drop rule, docs/parity.md)

libavif rejects the tmap payload because a gamma is 0 (avifGainMapValidateMetadata, AVIF_RESULT_INVALID_TONE_MAPPED_IMAGE, test DecodeInvalidGamma) and avifDecoderParse fails (status error); gainmap keeps the gain map (never-drop rule, docs/parity.md)

libavif rejects a tmap payload with bytes after the last field when writer_version is not above 0 (avifParseToneMappedImageBox, test ExtraBytesAfterGainMapMetadataSupporterWriterVersion: AVIF_RESULT_INVALID_TONE_MAPPED_IMAGE, status error); gainmap ignores bytes after the last field, as libultrahdr does, and keeps the gain map
